verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents installing one repository's skills into several agents at once (e.g. `-a claude-code -a opencode`), and claims support for OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 75 more. It writes into per-agent directories (`./<agent>/skills/`) and recommends symlinking each agent to a single canonical copy, so the per-harness layout is handled by the tool. Missing for 10: evidence of harness-specific instruction or content variants within a skill, and independent hands-on corroboration of a multi-agent install (the runtime probe only covered --version and --list).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -a claude-code -a opencode
Creates symlinks from each agent to a canonical copy. Single source of truth, easy updates.
